editor_fail.why: The main picture and both covers are infographics, but the story has a known place to show: the Tokyo Stock Exchange, which the story's own hero.need asks for. Together with the Cricket and Andhra infographics this pushes the homepage top over the one-third infographic limit. The figures on it (Nikkei -6.2% 'in morning trade', Kospi -7.1% 'later in the morning') date from about 7 am IST. Tokyo's morning session closed at 8 am IST, so they are already stale.
editor_fail.fix: Use a photo of the Tokyo Stock Exchange or a Tokyo electronic share board showing the Nikkei fall (quick_photo.py 'Tokyo Stock Exchange' or 'Nikkei stock board'), labelled as a file photo if not taken today. Keep the infographic only as an in-story graphic. Update the headline, text and graphic in English and Hindi to the Nikkei's morning-session close and the latest Kospi level, and to the Indian open if it is past 9:15 am.
